title: SCIENTOMETRIC ANALYSIS OF SCIENTIFIC PRODUCTION ON THE USE OF SILICON IN FRUIT PRODUCTION (2015–2024)
text_snippet: SCIENTOMETRIC ANALYSIS OF SCIENTIFIC PRODUCTION ON THE USE OF SILICON IN FRUIT PRODUCTION (2015–2024) Fruit production has significant economic, social, and environmental importance in national and international agricultural scenarios. However, fruit crops face challenges related to biotic and abiotic stresses and nutritional limitations. In this context, silicon (Si), although classified as a beneficial and non-essential element, has gained prominence due to its positive effects on stress tolerance, fruit quality, pathogen resistance, and physiological efficiency. This study aimed to conduct a scientometric analysis of scientific production on the use of silicon in fruit production from 2015 to 2024. The research was conducted using a quantitative and exploratory approach, based on data from the Web of Science database. Data collection was performed in April 2025 using the Boolean expression “Fruit” AND “Silicon”, applied to the title, abstract, and keywords fields. A total of 467 articles were identified, of which 108 were selected after screening for thematic relevance, duplication, and direct association with silicon use in fruit crops. title: FAMILY, SOURCES OF INFORMATION, AND RISKY SEXUAL BEHAVIOR AMONG ADOLESCENTS AND YOUNG PEOPLE IN MANAUS, AMAZONAS, BRAZIL
text_snippet: FAMILY, SOURCES OF INFORMATION, AND RISKY SEXUAL BEHAVIOR AMONG ADOLESCENTS AND YOUNG PEOPLE IN MANAUS, AMAZONAS, BRAZIL This article presents a section of the doctoral thesis entitled “Construindo pontes e derrubando tabus: experiências de adolescentes quanto ao comportamento sexual e fatores de risco associados a infecções sexualmente transmissíveis de estudantes na cidade de Manaus-AM”. Its aim is to analyze, based exclusively on the data produced in the original research, how family, school, the internet and other sources of information appear in adolescents’ and young people’s experiences regarding sexuality, prevention and risk behaviors associated with sexually transmitted infections. The study adopts a qualitative approach and used semi-structured interviews, a socioeconomic questionnaire via Google Forms and narrative analysis. The sample consisted of 24 students aged between 17 and 20 years, 16 female and 8 male. The results show that, although family appears as an important reference for sexual education, many interviewees report embarrassment, absence of dialogue or the search for guidance from siblings, uncles, cousins, friends and the internet. title: THE IMPACT OF THE HUMANIZATION OF GENERATIVE AI ON ORGANIZATIONAL CHANGE AND TALENT MANAGEMENT
text_snippet: THE IMPACT OF THE HUMANIZATION OF GENERATIVE AI ON ORGANIZATIONAL CHANGE AND TALENT MANAGEMENT Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) has impacted organizations. Sin embargo, aún existe una brecha en la comprensión de cómo su humanización afecta los procesos organizacionales. The purpose of this study was to examine the potential effect of the humanization of GenAI on organizational transformation and to clarify the consequences of such humanization on talent management. A review of the scientific literature was conducted between 2023 and 2025, using AI-assisted tools and a Boolean search equation, in Spanish and English. It was determined that the humanization of GenAI promotes adaptability to change, optimizes the work experience, and fosters innovation through a balance between technological and human capabilities. Moreover, it influences talent management through the automation of routine tasks, the personalization of professional development, and the promotion of human skills. It was concluded that the success of humanized GenAI is achieved by balancing technology and human competencies, through talent management with proactive leadership and continuous training strategies to build organizational cultures oriented toward innovation.

title: BETWEEN "SAFETYWASHING" AND NR-1: REFLECTIONS ON PSYCHOSOCIAL RISK MANAGEMENT AND SOMATIZATION IN THE WORKPLACE IN LIGHT OF THE "APRIL GREEN" MOVEMENT
text_snippet: BETWEEN "SAFETYWASHING" AND NR-1: REFLECTIONS ON PSYCHOSOCIAL RISK MANAGEMENT AND SOMATIZATION IN THE WORKPLACE IN LIGHT OF THE "APRIL GREEN" MOVEMENT The text critically examines the capacity of NR‑1 (2026) to address psychosocial risks and somatization in the workplace, highlighting the gap between normative rationality, ba sed on the “objective” identification and treatment of risks, and the subjective complexity of work‑related illness. It shows that many psychosocial phenomena remain invisible or institutionally denied, escaping traditional compliance tools. Drawing on authors such as Dejours, as well as guidelines from the ILO, publications from NIOSH, and contributions from classical psychosomatics, the article demonstrates that organizational factors such as work overload, harassment, and psychological insecurity translate into chronic stress, burnout, and physical symptoms. It argues that the standard can be effective when integrated with qualitative methods and a critical reading of organizational culture, but tends to devolve into safetywashing when applied bureaucratically. Thus, the ailing body emerges as an organizational indicator, revealing governance failures and underscoring the need for a risk‑management approach that acknowledges subjectivity, culture, and power relations.

title: INTENSIFICATION OF TEACHING WORK AND THE DISPLACEMENT OF RESPONSIBILITIES ONTO THE TEACHER
text_snippet: INTENSIFICATION OF TEACHING WORK AND THE DISPLACEMENT OF RESPONSIBILITIES ONTO THE TEACHER The work of Brazilian basic education teachers has expanded far beyond the classroom. Teaching now coexists with planning, marking, materials production, digital record keeping, meetings, continuing education, the organisation of projects and school events, attention to students and families, conflict mediation and emotional support, without a proportional increase in time, pay, autonomy or support structures. This theoretical, bibliographically grounded and qualitative article analyses this process as intensification, a category that cannot be reduced to longer working hours and encompasses the densification of the workday, the simultaneity of tasks, the fragmentation of time and the encroachment upon personal life. The guiding question asks how the expansion of pedagogical, administrative, organisational, technological, emotional and social demands intensifies teaching work and concentrates on the teacher responsibilities that the Constitution and educational legislation distribute among the State, school systems, school management, support teams, families and the community. title: ACTIVE METHODS AND DIGITAL TECHNOLOGIES IN THE TEACHING AND LEARNING PROCESS IN BASIC EDUCATION
text_snippet: ACTIVE METHODS AND DIGITAL TECHNOLOGIES IN THE TEACHING AND LEARNING PROCESS IN BASIC EDUCATION This study presents a reflective analysis of the use of active methodologies and digital technologies in the teaching and learning process in Basic Education. Active methodologies are pedagogical approaches that emphasize student participation, autonomy, and agency in the construction of knowledge, fostering the development of skills, competencies, attitudes, and values essential to a well-rounded education. In this context, digital technologies stand out as important pedagogical resources, capable of expanding the possibilities for interaction, collaboration, and learning when used intentionally and integrated with educational practices. The objective of this study is to analyze the contributions and implications of using active methodologies and digital technologies to promote a more meaningful teaching and learning process in Basic Education. It also seeks to understand how the integration of these approaches and resources can help address contemporary challenges in education, promoting greater student participation and new possibilities for knowledge construction. title: HUMAN RIGHTS IN EDUCATION: POSSIBILITIES AND CONTRIBUTIONS TO THE SCHOOL ENVIRONMENT
text_snippet: HUMAN RIGHTS IN EDUCATION: POSSIBILITIES AND CONTRIBUTIONS TO THE SCHOOL ENVIRONMENT This study analyzes the possibilities and contributions of human rights to the school environment, considering their relevance to citizenship education, the promotion of inclusion, and the strengthening of democratic pedagogical practices. It is based on the understanding that the school plays an essential role in the construction of values such as respect, dignity, social justice, and recognition of diversity. The objective of the research was to understand how human rights education can contribute to curriculum organization, teacher education, and the consolidation of more ethical and participatory school relationships. Methodologically, this is a bibliographic study with a qualitative approach and descriptive nature, developed through the analysis of scientific publications issued between 2020 and 2025 in academic databases and Brazilian scientific journals. The results indicate that human rights education constitutes an important foundation for building a school culture committed to citizenship, equity, and inclusion. title: ETHNOLOGY OF THE TVλ: FLOWS OF TOTAL PRESTATIONS
text_snippet: ETHNOLOGY OF THE TVλ: FLOWS OF TOTAL PRESTATIONS This paper discusses the archaic period of human exchange (c. 10,000–2,000 BCE) as a falsifiable empirical basis for the formalization of the Principle of Minimum Vital Action, as situated by Primo (2026) in Appendix A of the treatise Lambda-Value Theory (TVλ). It starts from the distinction between barter, proto-currencies, and Mauss’s category of “total prestations,” according to which, in pre-capitalist communal societies, equivalence in exchange does not stem from individual accounting but from a principle of equalization between groups, mediated by ritual, political, and affective bonds. Sahlins’s typology — Generalized, Balanced, and Negative Reciprocity — is reconstructed along with its historical degeneration into mechanisms of coercion and warfare, articulated with the “reverse dominance hierarchy” identified by Boehm in forager societies. The theoretical framework articulates this exposition with secondary sources from anthropology, archaeology, and political economy. The method is a hermeneutic literature review. title: FROM LAGRANGE TO MARX: ALGEBRAIC FOUNDATIONS OF DIFFERENTIAL CALCULUS AND THE FORMALIZATION OF TVλ
text_snippet: FROM LAGRANGE TO MARX: ALGEBRAIC FOUNDATIONS OF DIFFERENTIAL CALCULUS AND THE FORMALIZATION OF TVλ This paper discusses Karl Marx’s reading of Joseph-Louis Lagrange’s formulations of differential calculus, as situated by Primo (2026) in the mathematical foundations of Lambda-Value Theory (TVλ). It reconstructs the Marxian distinction between the “mystical differential calculus” of Newton and Leibniz, the “rational calculus” of d'Alembert, and Lagrange’s purely algebraic derivation, in which the derivative emerges as a coefficient of a series expansion rather than as a ratio of infinitesimals. Marx’s critique of Taylor’s theorem, the historical dispute over Landen’s priority, and the Lagrangian interpretation of the principle of least action from kinetic and potential energies are discussed. It is argued that TVλ, by adopting the multivariable Taylor expansion and the Lagrange multiplier method as the basis of its variational framework, critically inherits this algebraic legacy, and that the formalization of the multiplier λ as marginal vital expenditure per equivalent marginal utility performs a reversal — from symbolic result to operational category — analogous to the one Marx himself identified in the history of differential calculus. title: EQUITY IN MATHEMATICS EDUCATION: AN INTEGRATIVE LITERATURE REVIEW
text_snippet: EQUITY IN MATHEMATICS EDUCATION: AN INTEGRATIVE LITERATURE REVIEW Equity has become a central concern in Mathematics Education research, reflecting that access to schooling does not guarantee learning opportunities for all. Disparities related to race, gender, social class, language, and historical marginalization continue to shape students’ participation, achievement, and educational trajectories in mathematics. In response, researchers have examined equity across theoretical, pedagogical, and institutional dimensions. This study presents an integrative literature review that analyzes international academic production explicitly addressing the relationship between equity and Mathematics Education. The methodological framework was “Integrative Research Review” by Russell, the review draws on peer-reviewed articles identified through multiple academic databases and digital research platforms. The findings were organized into five analytical dimensions: theoretical and conceptual foundations of equity; identity, belonging, and trajectories of students; teacher training and teacher professional development; pedagogical practices and classroom strategies; policies institutional management and school organization. title: EDUCATION FOR AUTONOMY IN HIGH SCHOOL: THEORETICAL MODELS AND STUDENTS’ PERCEPTIONS AT A PUBLIC SCHOOL IN MANAUS, AMAZONAS, BRAZIL
text_snippet: EDUCATION FOR AUTONOMY IN HIGH SCHOOL: THEORETICAL MODELS AND STUDENTS’ PERCEPTIONS AT A PUBLIC SCHOOL IN MANAUS, AMAZONAS, BRAZIL This article analyzes the theoretical models applied to the teaching-learning process and the challenges of education for autonomy at Professor Jorge Karam Neto State School, a public school in Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil. The study was conducted with 82 high school students through a questionnaire consisting of open- and closed-ended questions administered via Google Forms between May 1 and May 20, 2022. The research was characterized as applied, exploratory, and descriptive, adopting both qualitative and quantitative approaches. Quantitative data were analyzed using descriptive statistics and percentage distributions, while the open-ended responses were grouped according to similarity. The findings indicate low student participation in paid work, volunteer activities, and extracurricular activities, as well as different understandings of autonomy, generally associated with freedom of choice, independence, and responsibility. Autonomy was perceived differently in personal life, the classroom, and the family environment. title: SCHOOL INSPECTION IN EDUCATIONAL GOVERNANCE: FOUNDATIONS, CHALLENGES, AND CONTRIBUTIONS TO EDUCATIONAL QUALITY
text_snippet: SCHOOL INSPECTION IN EDUCATIONAL GOVERNANCE: FOUNDATIONS, CHALLENGES, AND CONTRIBUTIONS TO EDUCATIONAL QUALITY This study aims to analyze the foundations and contributions of school inspection to the consolidation of educational quality and the effectiveness of public educational policies, highlighting its relevance as a mechanism for articulating legal frameworks, educational management, and institutional pedagogical practices. A qualitative bibliographic and documentary research design was adopted, based on the analysis of Brazilian educational legislation, official documents, and theoretical studies concerning democratic governance, educational administration, institutional evaluation, and school inspection. The findings indicate that school inspection extends beyond supervisory and regulatory functions, assuming an advisory, formative, and coordinating role that is fundamental to strengthening legality, administrative transparency, and the continuous improvement of educational processes. The study demonstrates that effective school inspection supports the implementation of educational policies, enhances democratic governance, and promotes institutional practices committed to equity, administrative efficiency, and the guarantee of the right to quality education. title: UPDATES IN THE MANAGEMENT OF SEPSIS AND SEPTIC SHOCK: AN INTEGRATIVE LITERATURE REVIEW
text_snippet: UPDATES IN THE MANAGEMENT OF SEPSIS AND SEPTIC SHOCK: AN INTEGRATIVE LITERATURE REVIEW Sepsis and septic shock are major causes of morbidity and mortality worldwide, requiring early recognition and prompt treatment to improve clinical outcomes. This study aimed to analyze the most recent updates in the management of sepsis and septic shock based on current scientific evidence. An integrative literature review was conducted using scientific articles, systematic reviews, meta-analyses, clinical protocols, and national and international guidelines published between 2020 and 2026, addressing diagnosis, monitoring, and treatment of the disease. The findings highlight that current recommendations emphasize the early recognition of sepsis as a medical emergency, the use of structured early warning systems, prompt administration of broad-spectrum antimicrobial therapy, fluid resuscitation guided by dynamic parameters, early use of norepinephrine in patients with refractory septic shock, and rapid source control. In addition, the evidence underscores the importance of antimicrobial stewardship programs, continuous monitoring of tissue perfusion, and the incorporation of new technologies to support the early detection of clinical deterioration. title: THE PROMOTION OF AFRO-BRAZILIAN AND INDIGENOUS IDENTITIES IN THE EDUCATIONAL CONTEXT: FOUNDATIONS AND CONTRIBUTIONS TO COMBATING PREJUDICE AND RACISM
text_snippet: THE PROMOTION OF AFRO-BRAZILIAN AND INDIGENOUS IDENTITIES IN THE EDUCATIONAL CONTEXT: FOUNDATIONS AND CONTRIBUTIONS TO COMBATING PREJUDICE AND RACISM This study aims to analyze the importance of valuing Afro-Brazilian and Indigenous identities in the school context as a means of promoting racial equity and combating prejudice and racism. The research is based on the understanding that schools play a strategic role in citizenship education and should promote pedagogical practices committed to cultural diversity and to the constitutional principles of equality and human dignity. A bibliographic study was conducted based on scientific literature, specialized works, and educational legislation, especially Laws No. 10.639/2003 and Nº 11.645/2008, which made the teaching of Afro-Brazilian, African, and Indigenous history and culture compulsory in Brazilian basic education. The findings indicate that the effectiveness of these public policies depends on continuous teacher education, the implementation of inclusive pedagogical practices, and school management committed to anti-racist education. It is concluded that valuing Afro-Brazilian and Indigenous identities is an essential element in building democratic and inclusive school environments committed to the promotion of human rights.

title: THE LEADERSHIP OF THE SCHOOL PRINCIPAL IN THE CONSOLIDATION OF COLLABORATIVE ENVIRONMENTS: CONTRIBUTIONS OF EDUCATIONAL LEGISLATION
text_snippet: THE LEADERSHIP OF THE SCHOOL PRINCIPAL IN THE CONSOLIDATION OF COLLABORATIVE ENVIRONMENTS: CONTRIBUTIONS OF EDUCATIONAL LEGISLATION This study aims to analyze administration and leadership within the school context, emphasizing the strategic role of the school manager in the consolidation of collaborative environments, in light of the contributions of educational legislation to the implementation of participatory management. It is based on the understanding that contemporary school management must be grounded in democratic, legal, and ethical principles, as established by the Brazilian Federal Constitution of 1988, the National Education Guidelines and Framework Law, and other regulations governing the Brazilian educational system. The research is characterized as a bibliographic study, drawing on theoretical contributions from the fields of educational management and Educational Law, as well as on the analysis of relevant legal provisions. The results demonstrate that leadership exercised in a participatory manner, supported by legal frameworks, fosters the strengthening of institutional relationships, the improvement of the organizational climate, and the promotion of more inclusive and collaborative educational practices. title: PEDAGOGICAL SUPERVISION AS EDUCATIONAL LEADERSHIP: CONTRIBUTIONS TO CONTINUING TEACHER EDUCATION AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
text_snippet: PEDAGOGICAL SUPERVISION AS EDUCATIONAL LEADERSHIP: CONTRIBUTIONS TO CONTINUING TEACHER EDUCATION AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT The increasing complexity of educational institutions, together with the social, political, technological, and cultural transformations affecting contemporary education, has significantly expanded the responsibilities assigned to pedagogical supervisors. In this context, their role has evolved beyond traditional administrative control to become a strategic form of educational leadership, fostering continuing teacher education, professional development, and democratic school management. This study aims to analyze the leadership exercised by pedagogical supervisors in promoting teachers' continuing education and to examine its contributions to pedagogical improvement and institutional development. A qualitative approach was adopted through bibliographical and documentary research, based on a critical review of national and international literature concerning pedagogical supervision, educational leadership, professional teacher development, and school management, combined with the analysis of Brazilian educational legislation. title: THE CHALLENGES OF DIGITAL LITERACY FOR TEACHERS
text_snippet: THE CHALLENGES OF DIGITAL LITERACY FOR TEACHERS This research sought to identify the challenges of teachers’ digital literacy. To support our discussions, we brought forward concepts from Soares (2012), Arruda (2018), Moran (2008), among others. The study has a qualitative nature and is based on bibliographic research carried out in the following stages: initially, we selected dissertations on the topic from the repositories of the University of Cuiabá (UNIC) and the Federal University of Mato Grosso (UFMT) from 2015 to 2025; subsequently, we began extracting and cross-referencing the information found; in the third stage, we proceeded with the interpretation and discussion of the results. Finally, we conducted a systematic analysis of all the collected data. We can infer that the dissertations evaluated highlight the need for teachers’ digital literacy to promote a conscious teaching and learning process. We hope that this work will contribute to discussions on the digital literacy of basic education teachers, thereby supporting the national debate.

title: THE USE OF CHESS IN MATHEMATICS TEACHING: A QUALITATIVE METASYNTHESIS
text_snippet: THE USE OF CHESS IN MATHEMATICS TEACHING: A QUALITATIVE METASYNTHESIS This article aims to identify and analyze the contributions of chess to Mathematics teaching based on studies selected from the CAPES Theses and Dissertations Catalog, within the time frame from 2020 to 2026. The study is characterized as a bibliographic review from the perspective of qualitative metasynthesis, using as its corpus eighteen dissertations classified as included or partially included, since, at the time of the search, no doctoral theses meeting the descriptors, time frame, and inclusion criteria were found. The analysis considered the relationship of the studies with chess, Mathematics teaching, problem solving, logical-mathematical reasoning, and the learning of mathematical concepts, organizing the findings into thematic categories. The results show that chess contributes to the development of logical reasoning, concentration, decision-making, autonomy, motivation, and strategy building, as well as supporting the learning of contents such as combinatorial analysis, geometry, the Cartesian plane, probability, percentage, and mathematical logic. title: INTERDISCIPLINARITY IN PERNAMBUCO'S BENCHMARK HIGH SCHOOLS: AN ANALYSIS OF THE OFFICIAL CURRICULUM AND INSTITUTIONAL DOCUMENTS
text_snippet: INTERDISCIPLINARITY IN PERNAMBUCO'S BENCHMARK HIGH SCHOOLS: AN ANALYSIS OF THE OFFICIAL CURRICULUM AND INSTITUTIONAL DOCUMENTS This study aimed to analyze the convergences and divergences between the principles of interdisciplinarity found in the official curriculum of the State of Pernambuco and their appropriation within the institutional documents of the Reference Schools in Secondary Education (EREMs) in Petrolina-PE, Pernambuco. This is a qualitative, document-based study conducted through an analysis of the National Common Curricular Base (BNCC), the National Curricular Guidelines for High School (DCNs), Pernambuco’s New High School Curriculum, pedagogical proposals, teaching plans available in the Pernambuco Education Information System (SIEPE), formative pathways, and elective curricular units from ten EREMs. The analysis was guided by a Multidimensional Matrix of Interdisciplinarity and grounded in Content Analysis. The results showed that interdisciplinarity holds a central position in normative curricular documents, being presented as a structuring principle of holistic education. However, its incorporation into the schools' institutional documents occurs unevenly, revealing varying levels of appropriation regarding curricular guidelines. title: STRUCTURAL BARRIERS IN PROFESSIONAL AND TECHNOLOGICAL EDUCATION: AN ANALYSIS OF THE SOCIOECONOMIC PROFILE OF FEMALE STUDENTS WITH DISABILITIES AT IFRO
text_snippet: STRUCTURAL BARRIERS IN PROFESSIONAL AND TECHNOLOGICAL EDUCATION: AN ANALYSIS OF THE SOCIOECONOMIC PROFILE OF FEMALE STUDENTS WITH DISABILITIES AT IFRO This article analyzes the socioeconomic profile of female students with disabilities enrolled at the Federal Institute of Education, Science and Technology of Rondônia (IFRO) in 2025, with the aim of understanding how structural barriers shape the objective conditions of access and retention in Professional and Technological Education (PTE). Grounded in the social model of disability and historical-dialectical materialism, the study adopted a quantitative descriptive approach, with data collected from IFRO's institutional database through the Access to Information Act (Law No. 12,527/2011). The sample comprised 239 participants, analyzed according to four indicators: type of disability, educational level, race/color, and family income bracket. The results reveal that 70.29% of the students self-declared as mixed-race (parda) or Black, 66.11% belong to families with a monthly income of up to one minimum wage, and participation in postgraduate programs is limited to 11.30% of the total, evidencing a progressive barrier to access at more advanced levels of education. title: EXPERIENCE REPORT ON THE CONTRIBUTION OF THE PET-SAÚDE PROGRAM IN PROMOTING COMMUNICATION ACCESSIBILITY IN LIBRAS (BRAZILIAN SIGN LANGUAGE) IN BASIC HEALTH UNITS IN MARABÁ/PA
text_snippet: EXPERIENCE REPORT ON THE CONTRIBUTION OF THE PET-SAÚDE PROGRAM IN PROMOTING COMMUNICATION ACCESSIBILITY IN LIBRAS (BRAZILIAN SIGN LANGUAGE) IN BASIC HEALTH UNITS IN MARABÁ/PA This study aimed to report the experience of conducting a Libras (Brazilian Sign Language) Workshop in Health, developed by students participating in the PET-Saúde Equidade Program, in the Basic Health Units (UBS) of the municipality of Marabá/PA, targeting health professionals. To this end, a bibliographic methodology with a qualitative approach and experience report was adopted. The experience in the Basic Health Units (UBS) revealed the crucial need for permanent Libras education to guarantee the communicational accessibility of deaf people, as provided for in legislation. The results pointed to the importance of projects that train health professionals, aiming at inclusive and equitable care, reaffirming that the right to health is universal and inalienable. It was concluded that there is an urgent need to continue such initiatives to fill the gap in the training of professionals able to serve the deaf community in Marabá.

title: TRANSCULTURATION AND RELIGIOSITIES IN THE LITERATURE OF ITAMAR VIEIRA JÚNIOR Transculturación y Religiosidades en la Literatura de Itamar Vieira Júnior
text_snippet: TRANSCULTURATION AND RELIGIOSITIES IN THE LITERATURE OF ITAMAR VIEIRA JÚNIOR Transculturación y Religiosidades en la Literatura de Itamar Vieira Júnior This article analyzes processes of transculturation and religiosity in the work of Itamar Vieira Júnior, investigating how the author’s fictional narratives structure the experiences of characters that constitute the “Deep Brazil.” The study adopts a qualitative, bibliographic, and interpretative approach, based on the critical reading of the author’s works and on dialogue with theoretical frameworks from cultural studies, anthropology, and literary criticism. The analysis demonstrates that Vieira Júnior’s literature articulates religious practices, collective memories, and traditional knowledge as central components of the narrative, highlighting coexistence, conflict, and cultural resignification. The results indicate that the author’s work constitutes a space for the aesthetic elaboration of transculturation and contemporary identity affirmation.

title: THE ELUCIDATION OF GEOMETRIC THINKING THROUGH DIGITAL TECHNOLOGIES: THE USE OF CHROMEBOOKS AND GAMIFICATION IN THE STUDY OF GEOMETRIC SOLIDS
text_snippet: THE ELUCIDATION OF GEOMETRIC THINKING THROUGH DIGITAL TECHNOLOGIES: THE USE OF CHROMEBOOKS AND GAMIFICATION IN THE STUDY OF GEOMETRIC SOLIDS This article discusses the use of Chromebooks and gamification as a teaching strategy in the teaching and learning process of geometric solids—specifically polyhedra and spherical bodies—in a 6th-grade class at a public elementary school in the state of Tocantins. The central objective is to analyze how the implementation of a teaching sequence, grounded in the integration of traditional teaching approaches and active methodologies (gamification), contributes to the development of students’ geometric mathematical thinking. The study is qualitative in nature. It adopts participant research as its research design and uses interactive quizzes on the Kahoot! platform as tools for developing the methodological approach and collecting data. The results indicate that the integration of devices equipped with digital technologies can foster conceptual understanding and, consequently, the transition from empirical to theoretical thinking, enabling students to identify spatial properties in a more meaningful way. title: THE INFLUENCE OF VETERINARIANS' OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH ON THE PROMOTION OF ANIMAL WELFARE
text_snippet: THE INFLUENCE OF VETERINARIANS' OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH ON THE PROMOTION OF ANIMAL WELFARE Occupational health of veterinarians has been recognized as an important factor for the quality of care provided to animals and for the effective promotion of animal welfare. In this context, this study aimed to analyze how the occupational health conditions of veterinarians influence the quality of animal handling and animal welfare, verifying whether healthy work environments positively contribute to professional performance and the adoption of humanized care practices. This is an applied study with a qualitative approach and an integrative literature review design. The search for studies was conducted in the SciELO, LILACS, Virtual Health Library, PubMed/MEDLINE, and CAPES Journals Portal databases, selecting Brazilian scientific articles published between 2020 and 2025 that address aspects related to occupational health in Veterinary Medicine and animal welfare. The results show that veterinarians are exposed to physical, biological, ergonomic, and psychosocial risks capable of compromising their physical and mental health, influencing clinical attention, decision-making, and the implementation of humanized handling practices. title: FACULTY HEALTH AND STUDENT ACADEMIC EXPERIENCE IN HIGHER EDUCATION: A LITERATURE REVIEW IN LIGHT OF THE JD-R AND SDT MODELS
text_snippet: FACULTY HEALTH AND STUDENT ACADEMIC EXPERIENCE IN HIGHER EDUCATION: A LITERATURE REVIEW IN LIGHT OF THE JD-R AND SDT MODELS This bibliographic review examined associations between university teachers' well-being and students' academic outcomes in higher education. The study was grounded in the Job Demands-Resources (JD-R) Model and the Self-Determination Theory (SDT). The bibliographic search was conducted in August and September 2025 across SciELO, BVS, CAPES Portal, PubMed, and Google Scholar, covering publications from 2000 to 2025. Thirty-eight scientific works were analyzed, organized into four thematic axes and submitted to content analysis following Bardin (2011). Evidence indicates positive associations between teacher well-being, quality of pedagogical practices, and student engagement, although causal claims cannot be made. The article proposes an original theoretical articulation between JD-R and SDT, positioning institutional conditions as antecedents of teachers' motivational states and, indirectly, of students' academic outcomes. Teacher well-being emerges as a relevant dimension of educational quality, with implications for institutional policies of teacher recognition and care.

title: STRENGTHENING PALLIATIVE CARE IN THE ICU OF A PUBLIC HOSPITAL IN THE FEDERAL DISTRICT: EXPERIENCE REPORT
text_snippet: STRENGTHENING PALLIATIVE CARE IN THE ICU OF A PUBLIC HOSPITAL IN THE FEDERAL DISTRICT: EXPERIENCE REPORT Introduction: Strengthening palliative care practices in intensive care units (ICUs) represents a challenge to the model focused on curative interventions. Objective: To report the experience of a resident doctor in the expansion of this approach in a public hospital in the Federal District. Method: This is an experience report, descriptive and qualitative, carried out in the ICU of the Asa Norte Regional Hospital, between April and May 2026. The activities include identification of selected patients, multi-professional discussions, structured family meetings and educational activities with a team. Discussion: We observed initial resistance related to wrong understanding of palliative care as therapeutic limitation. Progressively, there is more oil in the approach, better communication with family members, alignment of expectations and reduction of future interventions. Conclusion: The experience evidences the role of residents in the integration of palliative practices and reinforces the need for institutional strengthening and permanent education for the consolidation of humanized and non-patient-centered care.

title: DIGITAL MEDIA AND SCHOOL MANAGEMENT: A FOCUS ON INTERPRETATION, AUDIOVISUAL LANGUAGE, AND DECISION-MAKING PROCESSES IN SCHOOL ADMINISTRATION
text_snippet: DIGITAL MEDIA AND SCHOOL MANAGEMENT: A FOCUS ON INTERPRETATION, AUDIOVISUAL LANGUAGE, AND DECISION-MAKING PROCESSES IN SCHOOL ADMINISTRATION This research refers to the importance of reflecting on the use of technology in the classroom, focusing on digital media and audiovisual language in teaching Portuguese in a playful, objective, and technological way. The new digital media make it easier in the classroom, where videos, music, images, social networks are used, where the student is autonomous of his own knowledge and the educator has the role of facilitator of knowledge, obtaining good results in the applicability of new technologies, since he can authentically assimilate the concepts that refer to textual interpretation: hypertext, sender and receiver relationship, message and channel. The content was the interpretation of the love story by the writer Clarice Lispector, with the support of didactic technologies. It is concluded that the result obtained was that the students were stimulated during the classes, since the audiovisual language facilitates the textual understanding and the social media help, giving rise to an innovative didactic pedagogical perspective.

title: QUALITY MANAGEMENT IN THE UNIVERSITY CONTEXT AND ITS RELATION TO ACCREDITATIONS
text_snippet: QUALITY MANAGEMENT IN THE UNIVERSITY CONTEXT AND ITS RELATION TO ACCREDITATIONS In recent years, quality management in universities has gained considerable global importance, with over 100 countries adopting formal quality assurance systems to uphold academic standards (Jarvis, 2014; Nguyen et al., 2021). This trend reflects growing pressure from stakeholders demanding transparency and accountability for the investments made in higher education (Kereto et al., 2021). Many public universities have aligned their management practices with New Public Management principles, emphasizing evaluation, transparency, and effectiveness (Agasisti et al., 2017). External evaluations have become widespread, fostering institutional responsibility and measurable outcomes (Nyamwesa et al., 2020). As a response, universities are developing sophisticated internal quality assurance systems that substantially improve students’ learning experiences and academic success (Corengia et al., 2014; Kadhila & Lipumbu, 2019). Quality assessment serves dual functions: promoting continuous improvement and legitimizing institutions in society (Rashid, 2024). Overall, quality assurance has become central in demonstrating accountability and sustained progress in higher education (Williams, 2010)

title: ETIOLOGY AND PREVENTION OF DENTAL CARIES
text_snippet: ETIOLOGY AND PREVENTION OF DENTAL CARIES Dental caries is one of the most prevalent oral diseases among adolescents, showing a strong association with dietary factors, inadequate oral hygiene habits, and unfavorable socioeconomic conditions. This study aimed to analyze the main etiological factors related to the development of dental caries in adolescents, as well as to discuss the main preventive strategies aimed at promoting oral health in this population. This is a literature review, carried out using articles published between 2021 and 2026, in Portuguese and English, through searches in the Google Scholar and PubMed databases. After applying the inclusion and exclusion criteria, 11 articles were selected for qualitative analysis. The results demonstrated that the frequent consumption of foods rich in sugars and ultra-processed foods, associated with poor oral hygiene and socioeconomic vulnerabilities, significantly contributes to the increased incidence of dental caries in adolescents. Furthermore, it was observed that preventive measures, such as oral health education, nutritional guidance, fluoride use, and periodic dental check-ups, play a fundamental role in reducing cariogenic activity and promoting oral health.

title: SIMPLES NACIONAL AND ITS NEW OPPORTUNITIES UNDER THE HYBRID SYSTEM
text_snippet: SIMPLES NACIONAL AND ITS NEW OPPORTUNITIES UNDER THE HYBRID SYSTEM This article examines the new possibilities granted to companies under the Simples Nacional tax regime in the context of Brazilian consumption tax reform, focusing on article 41, paragraph 3, of Complementary Law No. 214/2025. The research problem consists of understanding whether the option to calculate and pay IBS and CBS under the regular regime can reduce competitive disadvantages faced by micro and small enterprises in commercial relationships with buyers subject to the regular tax regime. The general objective is to analyze the hybrid regime as a legal and economic instrument capable of increasing the competitiveness of these companies without fully removing them from the favorable treatment provided by Simples Nacional. The research adopts a qualitative approach, a deductive method and bibliographic-documentary procedures, based on the analysis of legislation, official documents and recent academic production on tax reform, non-cumulativity, tax credits and small businesses. The results indicate that the hybrid regime can make small suppliers more attractive in business-to-business transactions, since it allows greater use of tax credits by the purchaser. title: THE USE OF THE BAYLEY SCALE IN AUTISTIC PATIENTS WITH SELECTIVITY AND/OR FEEDING BEHAVIOR DISORDERS FROM A TRANSDISCIPLINARY TREATMENT PERSPECTIVE
text_snippet: THE USE OF THE BAYLEY SCALE IN AUTISTIC PATIENTS WITH SELECTIVITY AND/OR FEEDING BEHAVIOR DISORDERS FROM A TRANSDISCIPLINARY TREATMENT PERSPECTIVE The research is based on the MEII® Methodology (Integrated Intensive Stimulation Method), which proposes a transdisciplinary approach to the treatment of human developmental disorders, considering cognitive, motor, sensory, emotional, and nutritional aspects. Using the Bayley Scales of Infant and Toddler Development — the gold standard instrument for assessing children aged 1 to 42 months — the study analyzed the relationship between motor development and food selectivity in children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD). This is a cross-sectional, quantitative, and descriptive study conducted with 14 patients, of whom four met the methodological criteria. The assessments, complemented by the Labirinto Scale and the Sensory Profile, revealed that motor delays, sensory dysfunctions, and cognitive difficulties are often associated with food selectivity. title: EDUCATION AND HEALTH IN THE ASSURINI INDIGENOUS LAND OF TROCARÁ IN PARÁ
text_snippet: EDUCATION AND HEALTH IN THE ASSURINI INDIGENOUS LAND OF TROCARÁ IN PARÁ This article aims to analyze the relationship between education, health, and traditional knowledge at the Warara'awa Assurini Indigenous school, in the Trocará Indigenous Land, in Tucuruí (state of Pará, Brazil), in order to understand how the educational system currently in place at the school dialogues with the traditional cultural practices concerning the health of the Assurini people. This is a qualitative study that drew on semi-structured interviews conducted in the aforementioned TI with teachers and with the nurse of the Indigenous Basic Health Unit. Based on these interviews, the main normative and legislative discourses that underpin the relationship between education and health within the TI were presented, and the school's Political-Pedagogical Project was analyzed, taking the categories of culture, memory, and education as axes of interpretation. The results show that the school space constitutes an element inseparable from the transmission of traditional knowledge and health care within the Assurini Indigenous Land of Trocará. title: IMPACT OF SCREEN TIME ON THE COGNITIVE FUNCTIONS OF ADOLESCENTS
text_snippet: IMPACT OF SCREEN TIME ON THE COGNITIVE FUNCTIONS OF ADOLESCENTS Technological advancement has significantly transformed adolescents’ daily routines, expanding access to and use of digital devices such as smartphones, computers, tablets, and video games. Although these technologies provide benefits related to communication, entertainment, and access to information, increased screen exposure has raised concerns regarding its impact on cognitive and emotional development. Adolescence is a developmental stage marked by intense neurological and behavioral changes, making this population more vulnerable to the effects of excessive digital media use. Scientific evidence suggests that prolonged screen exposure may be associated with impairments in essential cognitive functions, including memory, attention, and academic performance, as well as behavioral changes, increased anxiety symptoms, and sleep quality disturbances. Another relevant factor involves reduced physical activity and sedentary behaviors, which also negatively affect cognitive development. In this context, the present study aims to analyze the influence of screen time on adolescents’ cognitive functions, focusing on its effects on memory, attention, and academic performance. title: THE (IN)EFFECTIVENESS OF LAWS TO COMBAT DOMESTIC VIOLENCE IN BRAZIL: AN ANALYSIS OF THE MARIA DA PENHA LAW (LAW NO. 11,340/2006), THE FEMICIDE LAW (LAW NO. 13,104/2015), AND LAW NO. 15,383/2026
text_snippet: THE (IN)EFFECTIVENESS OF LAWS TO COMBAT DOMESTIC VIOLENCE IN BRAZIL: AN ANALYSIS OF THE MARIA DA PENHA LAW (LAW NO. 11,340/2006), THE FEMICIDE LAW (LAW NO. 13,104/2015), AND LAW NO. 15,383/2026 This article article examines how effectively Brazilian legal norms against domestic violence and femicide actually protect women in practice, with particular focus on the Maria da Penha Law, the Femicide Law, and Law No. 15.383/2026. The study is based on the problem related to the persistence of high rates of gender-based violence in Brazil, despite the existence of legal protection and punishment mechanisms. The research aims to examine whether the current legal framework has been capable of preventing the escalation of domestic violence, protecting victims, and effectively holding aggressors accountable. To achieve this, the study adopts a deductive approach through bibliographic and documentary research, analyzing legislation, legal doctrine, and data related to violence against women. The results demonstrate that, although significant legislative advances have been achieved, structural shortcomings still persist in the enforcement of protective measures, state supervision, and the effectiveness of criminal prosecution, contributing to the continuity of femicide cases. title: IMPACTS OF REGULAR PHYSICAL ACTIVITY ON QUALITY OF LIFE AND RESPIRATORY FUNCTION IN OLDER ADULTS
text_snippet: IMPACTS OF REGULAR PHYSICAL ACTIVITY ON QUALITY OF LIFE AND RESPIRATORY FUNCTION IN OLDER ADULTS Population aging represents a major public health challenge, making it necessary to implement strategies aimed at promoting health and improving the quality of life of older adults. This study aimed to evaluate the quality of life and respiratory function of elderly participants enrolled in a community health promotion program conducted in the city of Cianorte, Paraná, Brazil. This was a cross-sectional and descriptive study involving older adults who regularly participated in health promotion activities. Data were collected using the Short Form Health Survey (SF-36), a widely used instrument for assessing quality of life, and the Peak Expiratory Flow (Peak Flow) test to evaluate respiratory function. The results showed higher scores in the social aspects domain and greater limitations related to physical and emotional aspects. Regarding respiratory function, variability was observed among participants, with part of the sample presenting some degree of ventilatory impairment. The findings indicate that physical, emotional, and social factors directly influence the autonomy and well-being of older adults. title: RURAL LAND REGULARIZATION IN THE LEGAL AMAZON AND ITS IMPLICATIONS FOR ENVIRONMENTAL PRESERVATION: A STUDY ON THE IMPLEMENTATION OF LAW NO. 11,952/2009 AT REGIONAL SUPERINTENDENCE SR 27
text_snippet: RURAL LAND REGULARIZATION IN THE LEGAL AMAZON AND ITS IMPLICATIONS FOR ENVIRONMENTAL PRESERVATION: A STUDY ON THE IMPLEMENTATION OF LAW NO. 11,952/2009 AT REGIONAL SUPERINTENDENCE SR 27 Rural land regularization in the Legal Amazon is marked by intense debate about its effects on environmental preservation, since the formalization of land ownership on public lands can both promote legal security and sustainable land use, as well as legitimize irregular occupations and encourage deforestation. Given this problem, the present work aims to measure the influence of rural land regularization on deforestation levels in the INCRA Regional Superintendency of Southern and Southeastern Pará State, within the context of the application of Law No. 11,952/2009. To this end, a qualitative-quantitative, exploratory, and descriptive methodology was adopted, with analysis of georeferenced data collected from the Land Management System, the Legal Amazon Deforestation Monitoring Program, and the Rural Environmental Registry System, covering the period from 2009 to 2025. The results reveal that the 1,345 titled properties, totaling 266,678 hectares, registered a deforestation rate of 3.1% in the analyzed period, while the remaining undesignated areas in the same federal public land parcels, with 5,316,289 hectares, presented 12.90% deforestation in the same interval. title: THE ROLE OF THE SCHOOL PSYCHOLOGIST IN THE INCLUSION OF CHILDREN WITH AUTISM SPECTRUM DISORDER
text_snippet: THE ROLE OF THE SCHOOL PSYCHOLOGIST IN THE INCLUSION OF CHILDREN WITH AUTISM SPECTRUM DISORDER This research consists of an integrative literature review with a qualitative approach, which aimed to analyze the role of school psychologists in mediating between the class group and children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) in Early Childhood Education. The search was conducted in the CAPES, PsycINFO, Google Scholar, and Redalyc databases, considering the period from 2020 to 2025. After screening and applying inclusion and exclusion criteria, four studies comprised the final corpus. The results show that the school psychologist's role is multifaceted, involving direct interventions with the child through playful and pedagogical resources, the instrumentalization of teachers through continuing education, family guidance, and collaborative consultancy. Mediation between the child with ASD and the class group constitutes a structuring axis of this practice, requiring articulated work that considers the relational, institutional, and subjective dimensions of the school context. title: THE IMPLEMENTATION OF SOCIO-EDUCATIONAL INTERNMENT MEASURES IN MARABÁ/PA: AN ANALYSIS IN LIGHT OF THE SINASE LAW AND THE ECA (STATUTE OF THE CHILD AND ADOLESCENT)
text_snippet: THE IMPLEMENTATION OF SOCIO-EDUCATIONAL INTERNMENT MEASURES IN MARABÁ/PA: AN ANALYSIS IN LIGHT OF THE SINASE LAW AND THE ECA (STATUTE OF THE CHILD AND ADOLESCENT) This study analyzes the implementation of the socio-educational measure of confinement applied in the municipality of Marabá/PA, from the perspective of the Statute of the Child and Adolescent (ECA) and the SINASE Law. The general objective is to investigate the mismatch between the legal pedagogical and socio-educational ideal and the practical reality of confinement in the district. A quantitative-qualitative methodology was adopted, through bibliographic research, documentary analysis of official reports from FASEPA and the Ten-Year Plan of the Municipality of Marabá, in addition to field research consisting of the application of a questionnaire to a public servant working in the local Public Defender's Office. title: THE VIOLINIST WHO DIDN'T MAKE IT? STIGMA, IDENTITY, AND THE HISTORICAL TRANSFORMATION OF THE VIOLIST IN THE ORCHESTRA
text_snippet: THE VIOLINIST WHO DIDN'T MAKE IT? STIGMA, IDENTITY, AND THE HISTORICAL TRANSFORMATION OF THE VIOLIST IN THE ORCHESTRA This article discusses the historical construction of the identity of the viola and the violist in the context of the evolution of the Western orchestra between the 16th and 20th centuries. Based on a review of the literature in historical musicology, organology, and studies on orchestral practice, the article analyzes how the viola occupied, for centuries, a secondary position in the instrumental hierarchy, often associated with harmonic filling and performed by musicians from the violin section. The text examines transformations in orchestral writing, in the composition of instrumental ensembles, and in the aesthetic function of the viola throughout the Baroque, Classical, and Romantic periods, highlighting technical, social, and symbolic factors that contributed to the consolidation of stigmas associated with the violist. It also discusses how the development of the repertoire, instrumental pedagogy, and the work of specialized performers, especially from the 20th century onward, fostered the strengthening of the viola’s artistic autonomy and the construction of a distinct professional identity for the violist within the Western musical landscape.

title: EFFICACY REPORTED IN THE LITERATURE ON NATURAL PRODUCTS OF PLANT ORIGIN MARKETED IN ZÉ DOCA-MA, BRAZIL
text_snippet: EFFICACY REPORTED IN THE LITERATURE ON NATURAL PRODUCTS OF PLANT ORIGIN MARKETED IN ZÉ DOCA-MA, BRAZIL This study investigated natural products sold in a specialty store in the municipality of Zé Doca (MA), focusing on the identification, categorization, and analysis of the characteristics of plant-based items. Aspects related to purpose, presentation, and traditional and contemporary uses were recorded, linking this information to scientific literature. The results show a wide diversity of food and phytotherapeutic plants, highlighted for their digestive, respiratory, anti-inflammatory, and metabolic potential. Beyond therapeutic and cultural aspects, it was observed that the trade in these products has a significant local economic impact, driving a growing market focused on the search for natural and accessible alternatives. However, challenges related to standardization, quality, safety, and scientific proof of attributed benefits persist. The study reinforces the need for oversight policies and incentives for research, as well as critical and informed consumption practices. It concludes that natural products represent not only a significant cultural and therapeutic resource but also an expanding economic sector that requires regulatory and scientific attention.
